members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2600: Both fix the same bug: when WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() runs while a JSON-response-mode POST is still in flight, the pending Promise<Response> for that request is never settled, so the HTTP request hangs until the platform's own socket/timeout kills it. #2600's changeset explicitly states 'close() also now settles JSON-response-mode POSTs that are parked waiting for their responses, answering 404 Session not found instead of leaving the HTTP request hanging' — the exact scenario #2692 targets with a per-request-id JSON-RPC -32000 'Connection closed' error instead.
